definitions.explanation: The process of a problem or situation becoming increasingly serious, severe, or difficult to resolve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The labor shortage is becoming more serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}い{止|と}め→食い止める：06384_kuitomeru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must stop environmental problems from getting worse.

examples.japanese: {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{社会保障|しゃかいほしょう}→社会保障：04914_shakaihoshou⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the worsening of the declining birthrate and aging population, a review of the social security system is being called for.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧ (serious, grave) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation suffix) = becoming serious/worsening. The 〜⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ suffix turns adjectives and nouns into verbs/nouns meaning "becoming ~."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深刻化|しんこくか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to worsen, to become more serious)
- {深刻化|しんこくか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (the worsening progresses)
- {深刻化|しんこくか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent worsening)

SIMILAR 〜{化|か} WORDS:
- ⟦{長期化|ちょうきか}→長期化：11108_choukika⟧ (prolongation, becoming prolonged)
- ⟦{悪化|あっか}→悪化：11077_akka⟧ (deterioration — more general than {深刻化|しんこくか})
- ⟦{複雑化|ふくざつか}→複雑化：21265_fukuzatsuka⟧ (becoming more complex)
